fees.note: Visa fee refunded only if visa not approved by Embassy

documents.name: Original Passport
documents.notes: Submit old passports also if any.
requirements: Minimum 6 months validity from date of travel

documents.name: Passport photocopy
documents.description: Photocopy of the Bio Data Page of current passport (First and Last Page)
requirements: Should be self attested with signature

documents.name: Passport Size Photograph
documents.description: One photograph taken within last 6 months

documents.name: Flight/Cruise Schedule
documents.description: Document to show the flight/cruise schedule to/from Japan
documents.notes: Can be booking confirmation or itinerary printout

documents.name: Itinerary in Japan
documents.description: Detailed itinerary in Japan in official format
documents.notes: MUST use official Japan itinerary format

documents.name: Latest Income Tax Return
documents.description: Latest Income Tax Return or bank statement of last 6 months if ITR not available
documents.notes: Either ITR or bank statement (last 6 months). A4 size photocopy.
alternativeDocuments: Should not be taken print out from bank website.
Get bank statement and balance certificate from your bank branch
Providing both ITR and bank statements are always a good idea

documents.name: Parent/Spouse Income Tax Return
documents.description: Latest Income Tax Return of parents/spouse or bank statement of last 6 months if student/dependent
documents.notes: Required only if applicant is student or dependent. A4 size photocopy.
alternativeDocuments: Bank statement of last 6 months (if ITR not available)

documents.name: Proof of Relationship
documents.description: Proof of relationship if applicant is accompanied by dependent
documents.notes: Can be passport copy, marriage certificate, or birth certificate

documents.name: Consent from Parents/Spouse
documents.description: Consent from parents/spouse if applicant is student or dependent
documents.notes: Required only if applicant is a student or dependent

importantNotes: All photocopies should be on A4 size only
The above is a guide to documents. Japan Embassy may request interview/additional documentation depending on personal circumstances
Documents submitted will not be returned except for the passport
Processing time is indicative only and may increase/decrease at discretion of Embassy of Japan, New Delhi
VFS Global is involved only in non-judgmental task of visa processing
